description.value:
You touch a weapon you're proficient with but that isn't already enhanced. While you wield it for the duration, it counts as an enhanced weapon that grants a +1 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and you may substitute your forcecasting ability modifier for Strength or Dexterity when attacking with it.

Cast with a 5th-level slot, the bonus becomes +2; cast with a 7th-level slot or higher, it becomes +3.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 3
